description: Check whether the helper has the permissions it needs: accessibility (required for everything) and screen capture (needed for screenshots). Use it when a tool fails with accessMissing or screenshots are missing. request: true shows the permission prompts / settings to the user; only do that when the user wants to set up permissions. You cannot grant them yourself.

request.description: true = show the operating system's permission prompts / settings to the user. Default false (just check).

name: access_status
title: Check permissions
